title: A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?
abstract: arXiv:2609.39564v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Delegating complete application development to coding agents requires preserving the intended design rather than simply producing plausible outputs through naive prompting. Game development provides a demanding testbed, as long-form Game Design Documents (GDDs) describe requirements that must work together across game logic, visual rendering, and player interactions. However, existing game-development benchmarks typically use compact specifications and provide limited support for evaluating interdependent requirements across these aspects in long-form GDDs. We introduce A2Z GameSpec-Bench, a benchmark of 100 long-form GDDs for evaluating end-to-end game development by agents. We measure faithfulness by checking whether the game satisfies the GDD requirements and preserves the relationships among them. Each GDD is turned into a dependency-aware contract that contains rules, constraints, and prerequisite relations. Following game-developme

translated_title: A2Z GameSpec-Bench：编码代理能够多忠实地根据游戏设计规范生成游戏？
translated_abstract: 将完整的应用程序开发委托给编码代理，需要保留预期的设计意图，而不是仅仅通过简单的提示生成看似合理的输出。游戏开发为此提供了一个极具挑战性的测试平台，因为长篇游戏设计文档（GDD）所描述的需求必须在游戏逻辑、视觉渲染和玩家交互等方面协同工作。然而，现有的游戏开发基准通常使用简短的规范，并且对于评估长篇 GDD 中这些方面之间相互依赖的需求的支持十分有限。我们提出了 A2Z GameSpec-Bench，这是一个包含 100 份长篇 GDD 的基准，用于评估代理的端到端游戏开发能力。我们通过检查游戏是否满足 GDD 的需求并保留需求之间的关系来衡量忠实度。每份 GDD 都被转化为一个依赖感知的契约，其中包含规则、约束和前置依赖关系。遵循游戏开发……
tldr: 该论文提出 A2Z GameSpec-Bench 基准，将 100 份长篇游戏设计文档（GDD）转化为依赖感知的契约，以评估编码代理在端到端游戏开发中还原设计需求的忠实程度。
en_tdlr: We introduce A2Z GameSpec-Bench, a benchmark of 100 long-form Game Design Documents converted into dependency-aware contracts to evaluate how faithfully coding agents can perform end-to-end game development.
